mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, here is today's balanced dish on the weather: conditions are clear at Verona City Hall with a temperature of 61 degrees. The overnight low will reach 57 degrees, and we are not expecting any rain.

City Hall has released several notices regarding the upcoming November 2026 General Election, and the Police Department has officially opened applications for their Citizen Academy, which provides an inside look at law enforcement operations.

It is a busy week in Verona, with live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company happening tomorrow. Looking further ahead, we have the Dane County Farmer's Market on the Square this Saturday, followed by the Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival in Verona later that day.

The Verona Police Department reported that on Friday, September 4, 2026, officers arrested a 34-year-old Madison woman for the sexual assault of a child by a school staff member regarding an incident reported from 2019.
Today's flavor was Dark Chocolate Decadence. The store is now closed for the night, but we look forward to serving up Raspberry Cheesecake when we open tomorrow morning at 10:00 AM.
